dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
God, help! There is a child in our garbage container! Someone left a baby here!!!
{WHERE ARE YOU?} Ma'am where are you calling from?
Behind a block at [[ADDRESS]].
Behind a block at 8th street 49
Behind a block at Arthur Avenue 5
Behind a block at Maple street 264
{IS IT BREATHING?} Is the baby breathing? Is it alive?
Yes, alive and crying! I thought it was a cat... Oh God!
{CAN YOU SEE IT?} Can you see the baby?
Yes, I can see and hear it! But I'm not able to reach it, I'm too short! It must be a newborn ...
{I'LL SEND THE FIREMEN} I'm sending the fire department to pull out the baby from the dumpster. I need you to stay there so they know where to go.
{STAND ON SOMETHING} Did you try to stand on something?
No, there's nothing really that I could use...
{LOOK AROUND} Look around. Is there anyone near by, somebody walking past? Maybe a neighbor?
Wait a second... I'll call someone! . . . . . . . . . . . . Mr. Wilson, Mr. Wilson! Please help me! . . . . . . . . There is a child inside, I need you to lift me up!
{PULL THE BABY OUT} Carefully pull the baby out of the dumpster.
dialogOption.COMMENT: Carefully pull the baby out of the dumpster.

dialogOption.texten: . . . . . . . . . . . . Ok, I did it! I have him in my hands!
{CAN IT BREATHE FREELY?} Make sure that baby can breathe freely.
Oh my... its mouth is full of mucus... I'll wipe it...
{WAIT FOR AMBULANCE} You're doing great. I've got ambulance on the way, so just wait there ok?
OK, I will wait right here, come quick!
Oh gosh... we have to do something!
Hello? Do something!

reportElement.texten: Life of the rescued child is not threatened. Parents of the child remains unknown.
The caller took the children out of a garbage container.
The caller provided first aid to the children.
